Which statement defines nucleon number?
A
It is the total number of protons in the nucleus of an atom.
B
It is the total number of electrons surrounding the nucleus of an atom.
C
It is the total number of neutrons in the nucleus of an atom.
D
It is the total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus of an atom.

options.label: A
options.text: It is the total number of protons in the nucleus of an atom.
